optimized.title: Pakistan Picks Iran
optimized.fullVoiceover: Pakistan picks Iran. Pakistan just made the choice that breaks the Quad by opening six overland routes through Balochistan, bypassing the blockaded Strait of Hormuz entirely. Three thousand containers stuck at Karachi just got rerouted. Pakistan's military is securing the Gwadar-to-Gabd corridor. On February 2026, China and Pakistan chose to side with Iran, while the US is alone with Israel. India, however, is the only major economy buying from both sides. New Delhi just became the most important phone call in geopolitics. Modi can pressure Tehran or Washington and still extract concessions. Pakistan picked Iran, but India picked everyone, including the US and China. So what does Washington do now, Pakistan?
